description: Start 24/7 monitoring of a URL. PingDeck checks the URL on a schedule and records each downtime and the SSL certificate expiry. An alert goes to the webhook of the account (see set_alert_webhook). An API key is necessary: call signup first.

api_key.description: A PingDeck API key (pd_live_...) from the signup tool. Not necessary when the client sends the key in the header "Authorization: Bearer <key>".

name.description: Optional. A short name for the monitor.

url.description: The URL to monitor, for example https://example.com.

name: create_monitor
title: Monitor a website 24/7
